note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs export entries with B/L numbers, destination ports (Genoa, La Spezia, Hamburg) and HS codes, latest 2026-02-28, shipping gear-box parts to the Italian parent Dinamic Oil S.p.A. and to B. Strautmann Soehne (Germany). Note the declared HS 842531 (winches) does not match the observed export HS 84834000 (gears/gearboxes) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual code is 84834000 (with 84814000 on the inbound valve line). Trade is largely intra-group (parent Dinamic Oil S.p.A. is the dominant counterparty, 1641+340+190+36 shipments), so it is genuine manufacturing/assembly in India feeding the group's European plants rather than independent third-party export. Registered address on record is DLF Tower Jasola, New Delhi, while the claimed state is Haryana — not verified either way.
